column2: Bob Dylan is credited as Written-By on “The Best Of Peter, Paul And Mary: (Ten) Years Together” and “Experience Hendrix - The Best Of Jimi Hendrix”. He is also credited as Organ and Backing Vocals on “Rattle And Hum” by U2.
Nate Haessly is credited as Recorded By on “Átta” by Sigur Rós. He is also credited as Engineer on “The Land Is Inhospitable And So Are We” by Mitski.
Laura Moody is listed as Cello on “Romance” by Fontaines D.C. and “Átta” by Sigur Rós.
Dan Wallin mixed “Camelot (Original Motion Picture Sound Track)” by Lerner & Loewe. He was also credited as an engineer on “Annie (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)” by Various.
Kevin Killen is credited as Mixed By on “Lazarus” and as Producer on “Rattle And Hum.”
Chris Galland is credited as Engineer on “Chris” by Christine And The Queens. He is also credited as Mixed By on “Born To Die” by Lana Del Rey.
Tom Elmhirst mixed “Lazarus” and “The Rise & Fall Of A Midwest Princess.”
Eddie Kramer was the engineer on “1” by The Beatles. He also worked as Remastered By, Engineer, and Producer on “Experience Hendrix - The Best Of Jimi Hendrix” by Jimi Hendrix.
Greg Kurstin contributed bass, engineering, and percussion to P!NK’s “Trustfall.” He also served as producer and wrote a song on Kendrick Lamar’s “Damn.”
Adam Clayton played bass guitar on “Rattle And Hum” by U2. He is also credited as Written-By on “Damn.” by Kendrick Lamar.
Larry Mullen is credited as Drums on “Rattle And Hum” by U2. He is also listed as Written-By on “Damn.” by Kendrick Lamar.
Manny Marroquin mixed “Chris” by Christine And The Queens. He also mixed “Born To Die” by Lana Del Rey.
Jerry Wexler produced “2 Originals Of Aretha Franklin” by Aretha Franklin. He also wrote “Tapestry” by Carole King.
Serban Ghenea mixed “Trustfall” by P!NK. He also mixed “The Rise & Fall Of A Midwest Princess” by Chappell Roan.
Brian Eno is credited as Written-By on “Lazarus.” He is also credited as Keyboards on “Rattle And Hum.”
